description: Defines the RangeBinary class in the Twig templating engine, representing a binary expression for range operations.

classes.name: RangeBinary
classes.description: Represents a binary range expression (.. operator) within Twig templates, compiling to PHP's range() function.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the range binary expression into PHP code, generating a call to range() with the left and right nodes.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string for the range operator used in templates, which is '..'.
